sculptural case seamlessly blends a circle with a square, inspired by Scandinavian artists and
architects who harmoniously merge nature's curves with tactile geometry.

[Shop His][140] [Shop Hers][141]

[Shop Jewelry][142]

Jewelry

Our jewelry pieces are effortlessly modern and uniquely refined, bringing a fresh approach to
everyday basics. Designed with organic shapes and minimalist details, they offer versatility and
comfort, perfect for layering and creating a sleek, polished statement.

[Shop His][143] [Shop Hers][144]

Skagen celebrates the Danish way of life: free, spontaneous, and in the moment. Our watches and
jewelry are fueled by a love of modern design––playing with color and current fashion influences.

We’re energized by the Copenhagen fashion scene and emerging Danish designers who mix and match bold
colors and patterns.

We’re finding refreshed inspiration in Denmark’s landscape—iridescent seas, vibrant skies, rocky
shorelines. Our modern designs draw from these natural influences.

We're dialed-in to purposeful design that speaks to the now—modern, functional, simple pieces with
enduring characteristics.

## Hardware Integrity: Precision Sensors & Military Durability

In Defense and Medical fields, data accuracy is not an option—it is a necessity. We don’t just
assemble watches; we architect the hardware from the chip level to ensure 100% reliability in
extreme conditions.

#### Dual-Chip Architecture

We use a high-performance 4G chipset for data transmission and a low-power MCU for 24/7 sensing.
Result: Real-time clinical data with an ultra-long 15-day battery life.

#### Raw Data Integrity

Clinical-grade pressure sensors (±3mmHg error) and 250Hz ECG raw data output. Result: We provide
pure, unedited data for your institutional research and algorithms.

#### Battle-Tested Reliability

Aerospace titanium body with Mohs 9 Sapphire glass. Built to GJB (Military) standards and 10ATM
waterproof. Result: Zero deformation under high pressure. Your data stays safe in any environment.

design to delivery to elevate your brand value.

# The **PINE64** community

Our goal is to push the envelope and deliver ARM and RISC-V devices that you want to use and develop
for. To this end, we actively work with the development community and champion end-user initiatives.
Rather than applying business to a FOSS setting, we allow FOSS principles to guide our business.

We are available on Discord, IRC, Matrix and Telegram, in the Forum and on Reddit.

**[Join our community][19]**
